q1_public_access.question: Is every data point publicly accessible without auth?
q1_public_access.notes: TTB Federal Register Lists are public government records, no authentication required.

q2_pii.question: Does it contain PII (personal email, phone, home address, SSN, financial account)?
q2_pii.notes: 3 PII violations removed by data-steward. Cleaned dataset contains business entity info only. All addresses are commercial facilities.

q3_robots_tos.question: Is any source's robots.txt or ToS violated by our harvest method?
q3_robots_tos.notes: Government public records. Direct CSV download from publicly posted files. No robots.txt restrictions apply.

q4_copyright.question: Are we reproducing copyrighted content verbatim?
q4_copyright.notes: Factual permit data. U.S. government works not subject to copyright (17 USC § 105).

q5_dual_use.question: Is any field dual-use or sensitive (security vulns, weapon specs, medical advice)?
q5_dual_use.notes: Business regulatory information. No security-sensitive or dual-use fields.

q6_putnam_test.question: Could a reasonable person whose data appears here object (Putnam test)?
q6_putnam_test.notes: Federal permit holders have no expectation of privacy. TTB publishes this data for regulatory transparency. No reasonable objection possible.

q7_gdpr_ccpa.question: GDPR/CCPA clean? Any EU/CA persons → ensure no PII, ensure right-to-erasure pathway.
q7_gdpr_ccpa.notes: Business entities with U.S. federal licenses. Not personal data under GDPR/CCPA. U.S. government public records.
